Definition: Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: The name Kemuel belongs to three different men: Nahor's son and the father of Aram in Abraham's family, a prince of Ephraim who helped divide the land, and the father of Hashabiah, a Levite leader under David. Same name, three lives, each named in his own place.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps the names straight even when we cannot, and each Kemuel is known to him in his own generation.
RelatedPeople: Kemuel; Kemuel, Son of Shiphtan; Nahor, Brother of Abraham
